shortDescription: UPSSSC has released Stenographer Advt 09/2023 Result 2026 for 333 posts. Download result PDF from upsssc.gov.in (declared 22 July 2026).
content:
UPSSSC has officially released the result for Stenographer Recruitment Advt. No. 09-Exam/2023.

Total posts: 333. Candidates who appeared in the mains examination can download the result from the commission website and check further selection stages.

Always use only upsssc.gov.in for authentic PDFs and notices.
